First downstream adjudication（首次下游裁决） for the collab-ranking mainline（协同排序主线） using fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） as the L2 carrier（第二层载体）. Evaluate（评测） reported root_branch_count（根分支数）=88 and constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0, so the weak result is not invalid constrained decoding（非法约束解码）. Result is clearly negative versus current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） and also below the strict recipe-aligned original baseline（严格配方对齐原版基线）; not promotable to RL（强化学习）.

Clean mid-graph replacement（中层图替换） adjudication for the collab-ranking family（协同排序方法族）: local_multihop（局部多跳图） clearly outperforms fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） inside the same loss（同一损失） and stop-gradient（停梯度） design. Evaluate（评测） reported root_branch_count（根分支数）=247 and constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0. Result is a clear gain over R720a on all main SFT metrics（监督微调主指标）, but it still stays below current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） and the strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调）. Treat this as the current screening winner（筛选胜出版本）, not a direct RL promotion（强化学习晋级）.

Strongest-recipe check（最强配方验证） for R720b local_multihop（局部多跳） tokenizer（分词器）. Switching to title_history2sid_off + desc_align_p05（关闭 title_history2sid 并开启 desc_align_p05） does not rescue downstream gap（无法挽救下游差距）: it is slightly worse than the title_on variant（title_on 版本） and still clearly below the strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调）. Evaluate（评测） reported root_branch_count（根分支数）=247 and constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0, so the remaining gap is not explained by invalid constrained decoding（非法约束解码） or recipe mismatch（配方错配） alone.

R720e downstream adjudication（下游裁决） for the collab-ranking（协同排序） family: same R720b local_multihop（局部多跳） L2 carrier（第二层载体） and same loss form（损失形式）, but L1 coarse pull（第一层粗图拉近） uses inverse ambiguity（逆歧义） item weighting（样本权重）. SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） improves over R720b on all @10 metrics and nearly matches the strict recipe-aligned original baseline（严格配方对齐原版基线） and current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） on HR@10, but remains slightly below both on NDCG@10 and below strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调）; not yet promotable to RL（强化学习） without further evidence.

R720f downstream adjudication（下游裁决） for the K1=128 capacity-constrained（容量约束） variant of R720e. SFT（监督微调） was first launched on 2 GPUs then resumed from checkpoint-399 on 4 GPUs with effective_global_batch（有效全局批大小） kept at 1024; wandb（实验跟踪） was disabled after the initial network timeout. Evaluate（评测） completed with constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0 and root_branch_count（根分支数）=124. Result is strongly negative versus R720e: NDCG@10 drops from 0.10094 to 0.08955 and HR@10 drops from 0.14604 to 0.13060. This suggests hard L1 capacity reduction（硬性第一层容量缩减） over-compresses the SID space（SID 空间） despite improving L1 compactness（第一层紧凑性） proxies; do not promote to RL（强化学习）.

Minimal collaborative edit（最小协同编辑） SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测）: original RQ-VAE（原版残差量化变分自编码器） base plus L3 local collaborative pull（第三层局部协同拉近） only, evaluated under title_history2sid_on+desc_align_p05. Result is below strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调） by NDCG@10 -0.00213 and HR@10 -0.00485, below strongest original RL（原版最强强化学习） by NDCG@10 -0.00567, and below v2_on_p05 SFT（当前 v2_on_p05 监督微调） by NDCG@10 -0.00112, but it is stronger than R720e on NDCG@10 and keeps HR@10 essentially tied with R720e. Verdict（裁决）: not RL-promotable（不可推进强化学习） yet, but it supports the low-disturbance collaborative-injection（低扰动协同注入） direction and motivates the running original_l2_multihop_ranking（原版第二层多跳排序） screen.

Minimal collaborative edit（最小协同编辑） SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测）: original RQ-VAE（原版残差量化变分自编码器） base plus L2 local_multihop ranking contrastive loss（第二层局部多跳排序对比损失） only, evaluated under title_history2sid_on+desc_align_p05. Result is slightly stronger than original_l3_collab_local（原版第三层局部协同） on NDCG@10 (+0.00006) and HR@10 (+0.00132), and stronger than R720e（R720e 协同排序） on NDCG@10 (+0.00071) and HR@10 (+0.00132). It is still below strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调） by NDCG@10 -0.00207 and below v2_on_p05 SFT（当前 v2_on_p05 监督微调） by NDCG@10 -0.00106, though it beats v2_on_p05 on HR@10 by +0.00110. Verdict（裁决）: not directly RL-promotable（不可直接推进强化学习） yet, but it is the current best minimal-edit collaborative-injection（最小编辑协同注入） screen and supports testing weak L2 ranking + weak L3 local pull（弱第二层排序加弱第三层局部拉近） next.
